rca of the issue: AI Claude calls fail with AttributeError because the installed emergentintegrations LlmChat class no longer exposes .with_max_tokens (or never did in this version). The fluent-builder chain `.with_model(...).with_max_tokens(2000)` raises immediately. The try/except in ai_planner.py catches it and invokes _fallback_route_plan / _fallback_performance, which return correctly-shaped JSON, so the HTTP layer returns 200 and the UI renders. Fix: drop .with_max_tokens(...) — Claude defaults to a reasonable max — or check emergentintegrations docs for the correct setter (e.g. .with_params(max_tokens=2000) or constructor arg).
